I fixed this in `src/Lexer.ts`, but I haven't run it. The folder has no `node_modules`, so I didn't build it or run any tests, and I didn't try your two examples.

**Cause:** in `#inlineTokensInner`, the lexer builds a masked copy of the line before looking for emphasis. It masked backslash escapes first, then masked code spans. In `` `C:\Users\` ``, the `` \` `` at the end looked like an escaped backtick, so it was masked. The code span then had no closing backtick, and its contents and the text after it were no longer masked correctly. That is why `**home**` stayed literal.

**Fix:** the escape masking now walks the line left to right in one pass and skips over code spans, so a backslash inside one is no longer treated as an escape. Unmatched backtick runs are also skipped over whole. A real escaped backtick outside a code span, such as `` \` ``, is still masked as before.
